newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SUPERSPORT SERIES CLOSE OF PLAY SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SUPERSPORT SERIES CLOSE OF PLAY SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores on the third day of four-day Supersport series cricket matches on Sunday.
In East London: Border 400 and 192-5 declared (Piet Botha 90 not out). Griqualand West 253 (Piet Barnard 79) and 38-1.
In Paarl: Free State 254 and 264 (Hansie Cronje 52). Boland 264 and 146-5 (Kosie Venter 4-51).
In Johannesburg: Natal 407 and 241-8 declared (Clive Eksteen 4-75). Transvaal 241 (Ken Rutherford 88; Shaun Pollock 4-58; Lance Klusener 4-61) and 4-0.

In Port Elizabeth: Eastern Province 432-9 declared and 161-2 declared (Louis Koen 75, Carl Bradfield 50 not out). Northern Transvaal 272 (Richie Richardson 69, Gerald Dros 54; Eldine Baptiste 5-56) and 9-2.
